title: Independent game migration passes source and release acceptance
context: The extraction needed to preserve a playable baseline while removing research-shell coupling, unsafe cross-app caching, ambiguous simulator outcomes and duplicated decision indexes. The first browser checks exposed a tutorial proof gate in the acceptance setup and mobile-only service-worker registration in the product.
outcome: Stalheart now has independent game, Workshop and Settings entries, canonical module identity, deterministic dist output, scoped storage/cache ownership, typed economy accounting, protected sector-breach funding, validated simulation results, local diagnostic export and an immutable development log. The browser fixture ends the tutorial before forcing a sector clear; real cold-open interaction is tested separately. PWA startup moved to the shared application entry and now installs on desktop as well as mobile. Terraformer 3000 preserves animated pivots, common damage-state scale and authored palette with a faint own-color fill for the dark board. Sixty Node test programs passed. Source acceptance and release acceptance under /stalheart/ passed, including actual sector buttons, retry, both rosters, mobile input probe, both missions, three hacks, four labs, all Terraformer states and release service-worker control. Two builds produced identical release manifests: d7606185, 380 files, 63,924,970 bytes. No remote or deployment was created.
alternatives: Preserve the inherited wave formula during migration. Passing short bot loss baselines is not evidence that all five sectors are balanced or winnable.
Keep Terraformer 3000 opt-in until real-device performance and visual review support promotion. D0 has 78 merged meshes and 165,404 triangles; D1/D2/D3 are damage states, not performance LODs.
Use full-page route ownership to prevent hidden renderer accumulation now; extraction of the remaining combat/render/tutorial closure and sector suspend/resume remain next-phase work.
evidence: npm test: 60 isolated programs passed; includes campaign solvency/accounting, storage migration, result identity, log integrity, asset animation and scoped service-worker behavior.
npm run check: syntax, canonical source imports, unchanged kernel hashes, development log and 37 pinned Sentry assets passed.
npm run build: d7606185; repeat build byte-identical release.json. Release payload excludes private logs, docs, tests and source audio originals.
npm run test:browser: source acceptance passed; artifacts/browser contains screenshots, full console/network logs and sim-1.json/sim-2.json.
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --dist: nested-path release acceptance and PWA control passed; artifacts/browser-dist contains equivalent evidence.
Both seed-1000 style1 roster baselines end in loss at wave 3, approximately 87 simulation seconds, consistent with the research baseline; no full campaign success is claimed.
Project deban SKILL.md passed skill-creator quick_validate.py in an isolated temporary Python environment.
Original research: test/pwa.mjs, check-tokens.sh and export-helper syntax passed after its scoped cache and handoff edits.

docs/MIGRATION.md and docs/STATE.md list remaining limitations: real iOS/touch/audio, campaign playtesting, difficulty tuning, monolith extraction, asset optimization, suspend/resume and complete offline installation.
